title: Data, people and growth: Join us at DataConnect26
authors: Rachael Richards, Data Community Lead, GDS

content.text: DataConnect, the Office of the Chief Data Officer’s flagship conference for public sector data professionals, returns this October, bringing together public sector data, digital and artificial intelligence (AI) professionals from across government, local authorities, the NHS, academia and beyond.
Join us on 6 and 7 October 2026 by registering for free: Register for DataConnect26 on RingCentral.

This year’s theme is data for growth, for people, for places. At a time when government is focused on driving economic growth, improving public services and devolving power, DataConnect26 will explore the role data plays in providing better outcomes for citizens and communities across the UK.

Through case studies, panel discussions and practical examples, attendees will hear how organisations across the public sector are addressing shared challenges, improving their data foundations and turning data into real-world results. The programme will also explore some of the biggest opportunities and challenges facing the public sector data community today, and how we can work together to address them.
Working closely with Aimee Smith, Government Chief Data Officer, we have taken a different approach to developing this year’s programme.
Rather than issuing an open call for speakers, the programme has been curated around emerging cross-government priorities and the main challenges facing the public sector data community today.
